pharmacy.name: Matsumoto Kiyoshi (Shinjuku East)
pharmacy.note: OTC meds, English labels on many items

scam_warnings_extra.title: Last train timing trap
scam_warnings_extra.body: Missing the last Yamanote/Metro train (~midnight) forces ¥5,000+ taxi rides from Shinjuku or Roppongi.

hospital.name: Kyoto University Hospital
hospital.note: Major ER; limited English — bring translation app

scam_warnings_extra.title: Geisha photo fee scam
scam_warnings_extra.body: Unlicensed 'geisha' near Gion may demand ¥10,000+ after photos — real maiko rarely pose on street.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Dotonbori overpriced bars
scam_warnings_extra.body: Touts offering 'cheap drinks' may add hidden cover charges — check menu prices before entering.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Pickpocket zones
scam_warnings_extra.body: Metro Line 1, RER B to CDG, Trocadéro, Sacré-Cœur stairs — bags in front, zippers closed.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Beach chair rental overcharge
scam_warnings_extra.body: Always confirm price before sitting — some operators charge €30+ without clear signage.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Tuk-tuk 'temple closed' scam
scam_warnings_extra.body: Driver says Grand Palace is closed — it is almost always open mornings. Walk to official entrance.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Jet ski damage scam
scam_warnings_extra.body: Photograph jet skis before use — pre-existing scratches are often blamed on renters.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Currency conversion scams
scam_warnings_extra.body: Unlicensed booths near Sultanahmet — use Ziraat ATMs, decline DCC.

pharmacy.name: Pharmacy Syntagma (24h rotation)
pharmacy.note: Check green cross for on-duty pharmacy

scam_warnings_extra.title: Acropolis ticket resellers
scam_warnings_extra.body: Buy only from official website or on-site kiosks — street sellers often charge 2× for invalid tickets.

hospital.name: Santorini General Hospital (Karterados)
hospital.note: Limited ER — serious cases may airlift to Athens

scam_warnings_extra.title: Donkey ride overpricing
scam_warnings_extra.body: Confirm round-trip price before Fira–Old Port donkey ride — disputes common at the bottom.

hospital.name: Mykonos Health Center
hospital.note: Basic ER; complex cases transferred to Syros/Athens

scam_warnings_extra.title: Unlicensed money changers
scam_warnings_extra.body: Street changers on Jalan Legian use sleight-of-hand — use authorized booths with posted rates only.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Scooter rental damage claims
scam_warnings_extra.body: Video-document scratches before riding — common scam at cheap rental shops.

hospital.name: Ubud Clinic / Siloam (Denpasar for ER)
hospital.note: Minor care in Ubud; serious trauma → Denpasar

scam_warnings_extra.title: Las Ramblas pickpockets
scam_warnings_extra.body: La Boqueria, metro L3, and beach promenade — teams work in groups; never leave phone on table.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Colosseum skip-the-line fake guides
scam_warnings_extra.body: Only official co-opce.it partners sell valid skip passes — ignore aggressive sellers at Metro exit.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Restaurant cover charge surprise
scam_warnings_extra.body: Coperto/service not always on menu board — ask before sitting at tourist squares.

hospital.name: Ospedale dell'Angelo Mestre
hospital.note: Main ER — vaporetto to Piazzale Roma then taxi

scam_warnings_extra.title: Gondola price ambiguity
scam_warnings_extra.body: Official daytime rate is posted — agree route and price before boarding; avoid 'special tour' upsells.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Desert safari hidden charges
scam_warnings_extra.body: Confirm quad bike/dinner package in writing — bait-and-switch at camp common.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Orchard Road fake charity
scam_warnings_extra.body: Aggressive clipboard sign-ups — legitimate charities won't block sidewalks.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Oxford Street / Tube pickpockets
scam_warnings_extra.body: District Line, Oxford Circus — bags zipped, phone not in back pocket.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Times Square CD/mascot pressure
scam_warnings_extra.body: Costumed characters demand tips after photos — say no and keep walking.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Fake ticket sellers
scam_warnings_extra.body: Buy Statue of Liberty & Broadway tickets only from official sites or box office.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Auto-rickshaw 'closed monument' route
scam_warnings_extra.body: Drivers redirect to commission shops — use Uber/Ola or metro to official site.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Bondi rental bike deposit trap
scam_warnings_extra.body: Document bike condition — disputed damage charges at some rental kiosks.

hospital.name: Seoul National University Hospital
hospital.note: Top tier ER; translation apps help

scam_warnings_extra.title: Itaewon bar overcharging
scam_warnings_extra.body: Check drink prices on menu before ordering — tourist bars occasionally pad bills.

scam_warnings_extra.title: Motorbike taxi wrong change
scam_warnings_extra.body: Count change before xe om rides away — 500k vs 20k note confusion is common.
